title: Albert J. Weatherhead, Jr. Professor of Business Administration, Emeritus
bio: Securities Industry I have recently published two books about the bull market of the 1990s. The first deals with the internet bubble; the second deals with the large company financial reporting scandals. Both books consider the events, causes (including matters of ethics) , and what might be done about the situation.

He has been a director of publicly-listed firms and is currently a director of several closely-held private corporations.
